checkpoints.description: [1/4] Planning: reproduce play.bat double-click crash (exit 255) from unescaped banner pipes and LF-only endings; fix and failing-first regression tests designed

impact_assessment.why: Clicking play.bat or voidfarer.bat on Windows aborts before the menu: unescaped '|' characters in the ASCII banner pipe the echo into a nonexistent '_' command, cmd exits 255 and the console window vanishes, so the reported symptom is 'nothing happens'. Both launchers also ship LF-only line endings, which is fragile for cmd block parsing.
impact_assessment.benefits: One-click launch works again for both launchers; every menu option path renders and exits cleanly; two regression tests (CRLF policy unit test, Windows-only menu integration test) pin the exact double-click flow so future tool rewrites cannot silently break it.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none - no Python API, CLI surface, save schema or REST contract changes, only launcher text and a new test module; dependency: none new - tests use stdlib subprocess/pathlib only and skip off Windows; concurrency: none - the tested path exits before any server or ticker starts; state: none - tests only read files and exercise the exit-only menu path, never touching the player save.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Re-run the exact failing invocation before and after the fix (cmd /c play.bat with piped input), keep the menu test on the exit-only choice [0] so it cannot start a server or open a browser, verify CRLF conversion byte-level in a dedicated unit test, and gate the commit on the full suite plus aikit.py check voidfarer.

checkpoints.description: [1/5] Re-plan after Phase 4 gate failure: cmd_relics calls calculate_passive_multipliers with the wrong arity and prints absent keys, crashing any save with relics; CLI/story tests resolve main() storage to the live save (%LOCALAPPDATA%\.voidfarer) and mutate it; milestones extended with failing-first coverage for both

impact_assessment.why: The Phase 4 gate exposed two real defects beyond the launcher: cmd_relics passes two arguments to calculate_passive_multipliers(ship) and prints keys absent from its result, so any save with relics now crashes the relics command; and CLI/story tests call main() without isolation, which resolves default storage to the player's live save in LOCALAPPDATA\.voidfarer, so test runs read player progress and mutating test commands (power) write it back.
impact_assessment.benefits: The relics command works again for saves with relics, the automated suite can no longer read or write the player's live save, and a seeded regression test pins the relics rendering path so the API drift cannot silently return.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none - calculate_passive_multipliers keeps its shape, only cmd_relics's call and output keys change to match it; dependency: none; concurrency: none - CLI tests remain single-threaded; state: tests isolate storage by patching LOCALAPPDATA/HOME/USERPROFILE into per-test temp dirs, no schema or save-format change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first: seed a save with all story relics and run main(['relics']) before the fix; after the fix, hash LOCALAPPDATA\.voidfarer\voidfarer_save.json before and after full suite runs to prove the live save is untouched; gate on the full suite plus aikit check voidfarer.

checkpoints.description: [5/5] Verification and ship: 124/124 tests green in 2.1s; aikit check 4/4 (test, hygiene, guidelines, secrets); launcher menu, relics vault, and live-save isolation proven end-to-end; docs updated (README counts, ADR-011/012). checklists: passed
Task 'task-voidfarer-launcher-fix-v1' completed successfully.

[1/5] Planning cockpit layout rules (G-001..G-003): telemetry log anchored lower-right with HIDE/SHOW button; chrono tick deck pinned to the far right of the top status bar; Commerce/Arsenal/Fleet terminal rebuilt as a vertical tab rail on the left with content beside it; radar+reactor center column; alerts center-top; failing-first DOM/CSS regression tests designed

impact_assessment.why: The cockpit currently places the telemetry log in the center deck, the chrono deck mid-bar, and the Commerce/Arsenal/Fleet terminal as a horizontal tab strip on the right. The user's layout rules require the log at the lower-right with a hide button, the chrono settings in the right upper corner, and the terminal running vertically down the left side.
impact_assessment.benefits: The cockpit matches the user's ergonomics: terminal rail on the left, main view center, time controls and telemetry in their expected corners; the log can be collapsed to free screen space; the rules become pinned by structural regression tests (G-001..G-003).
impact_assessment.risks: contract: app.js-referenced DOM ids (tab buttons/contents, chrono controls, log stream, clear button) must not change; dependency: none, tests use the stdlib html.parser; concurrency: none, static assets only; state: the HIDE/SHOW toggle is view-only and adds no persisted state; grid column fractions change the visual balance of all three decks.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first: structural tests parse index.html and assert deck membership, document order, CSS pins, and JS wiring before the restructure; smoke-serve the static cockpit afterwards; full suite plus aikit check gates before commit.

[5/5] Verified: full suite 135/135 in 2.3s; served-cockpit smoke 200 on /, /style.css, /app.js with layout markers present; aikit check 4/4; ADR-013 and README 135-count updated; checklists: passed

[1/4] Plan: make inert hardware stat_bonus effects and chassis perks real, add failing-first tests for aggregation and engine integrations, and repair the launcher test's env-sensitive invocation

impact_assessment.why: ADR-010 deferred wiring of inert upgrade stat bonuses and chassis perks; players currently buy modules whose advertised effects (fuel, scan, combat, shield regen, evasion, ECM) do nothing, and the 135-test baseline is red in this environment because NoDefaultCurrentDirectoryInExePath=1 makes 'cmd /c play.bat' unresolvable
impact_assessment.benefits: Every advertised module and chassis perk changes gameplay; bonuses are centralized and test-pinned; launcher regression test becomes portable across hardened Windows hosts
impact_assessment.risks: contract: preserve save schema, REST/CLI shapes and catalog ids; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: pure calculation under the existing engine lock; state: no new persisted fields, chassis lookup stays class-based
impact_assessment.mitigation: Pure calculate_equipment_bonuses(ship) helper, additive/multiplicative rules documented in ADR-014, integration tests compare before/after behavior, absolute launcher path in the subprocess test, full suite plus aikit check gate

checkpoints.description: [4/4] Verified: 146/146 tests green (2.1s); aikit check voidfarer 4/4 (test, hygiene, guidelines, secrets); new 11-test equipment suite red-first then green; launch test now uses absolute play.bat path; README counts/tree + ADR-014 updated; checklists: passed

[1/5] Audit-driven hardening: engine input/data-integrity guards, storage atomicity and backup recovery, server request validation and lifecycle, CLI parity, and cockpit runtime fixes, each with regression tests

impact_assessment.why: A full-project audit found exploitable or corrupting defects: negative repair/refuel amounts mint credits and reduce hull, failed atomic saves report success, malformed REST payloads 500, upgrade swaps leave ghost modules, drone harvest ignores cargo volume, CLI help/README advertise unreachable commands, and cockpit controls mis-handle pre-load state, power sync, and cargo volume
impact_assessment.benefits: Prevents economy corruption and save loss, turns malformed requests into explicit 400 responses, restores documented CLI surfaces, makes cockpit pointer/power/cargo state match the engine, and adds regression coverage for each repaired path
impact_assessment.risks: contract: REST/CLI additive changes only, save schema unchanged; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: storage lock plus unique temp names, no new threads; state: no migration, but failed saves now raise instead of silently succeeding
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first tests per milestone, narrow helpers for validation and storage, full suite plus aikit check, and ADR-015 documenting each change's trade-off and residual risk

checkpoints.description: [5/5] Verified: 179/179 tests green (2.5s), node --check app.js OK, compileall OK, aikit check voidfarer 4/4 (test, hygiene, guidelines, secrets); ADR-015 records implemented fixes, trade-offs, and deferred gaps; checklists: passed
Task 'task-voidfarer-audit-hardening-v1' completed successfully.

[1/4] Plan: add adaptive enemy AI intents/profiles, expand every star system to 5-6 planets with guaranteed docking, and display an in-game calendar date (DD.MM.YYYY) alongside ticks across engine, CLI, server, and cockpit

impact_assessment.why: The game currently has scripted enemy abilities, only 2-3 planets per system, and a hard-to-read stardate; the requested feature set needs deterministic, save-compatible additions that preserve existing combat, economy, time, and HUD contracts
impact_assessment.benefits: Enemies react to player combo, hull, and shields; exploration/trading gets roughly double the planets with guaranteed stations; players see an intuitive date while stardate and tick data remain available to existing consumers
impact_assessment.risks: contract: CombatEncounter save fields are additive with defaults, TimeState keeps stardate, body_1..body_3 ids stay stable; dependency: stdlib datetime only; concurrency: AI decisions are pure functions under the engine lock; state: new enum-like strings default safely on old saves
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first tests for policy branches and combat deltas, galaxy invariants, and date rollover; ADR-016 records trade-offs; full suite plus aikit check gates

[1/5] Frontier Command expansion: main menu/save management, centered black NAV-radar overlays, AI captains and dynamic economy, quests/depots/quantum messages, landing/moons/star types, mercenary/fleet/ally systems, transit animation, and branching perks window

impact_assessment.why: The requested feature set adds major player-facing surfaces and persistent entities; implementing them without a plan risks breaking save compatibility, the existing 196-test suite, and the cockpit layout rules
impact_assessment.benefits: One coherent frontier layer ties AI trade to prices, surfaces unit/depot/message state, adds save management and procedural depth, and converts the perks page into a branchable window while keeping all prior systems working
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new REST endpoints and additive save fields; dependency: stdlib only plus existing web assets; concurrency: AI/depot/message mutations use the engine lock; state: legacy saves bootstrap AI/depots/messages and keep stored systems
impact_assessment.mitigation: Per-domain regression tests, additive serialization defaults, node syntax check, full suite, and aikit 4/4 gates
